notes.title: Demo Release Update
notes.content:
[h1][i]Updates?[/i][/h1]

It's been a long time coming and we are happy to share with you our official demo.
While the demo has been out for a week now for Gamescom, a few updates have been made to ensure a more stable and enjoyable run for our community.  

Simply visit our store page to access our demo here:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/1306010/BADA_Space_Station/

For the demo, region select is implemented and is encouraged when playing with one or more people! 
As for character and arena availability, 2 characters are available to play (Dr Scrap and Puppeteer) on the Mechanical Level. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38219030/69d5c4b3ae88b06e229d6754e84844c7a8e66218.png[/img]

Special access will be granted to testers, press, or streamers who would like to cover the game. This can be discussed with us via email (aika@terahard.org)!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38219030/c16393d497357519d22b229e58db9ae4a8432f4f.png[/img]

We continue to improve the game and fix bugs as they are reported so if there are any feedback you think is worth noting, do drop by our Discord and tell us about your experience! 
[url=discord.gg/pcuSnwU8MB][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38219030/829848634ca0a3d0d9af6140b1865d7dac5694b1.png[/img][/url]
Our goal is to make a game that we can all enjoy.

We hope to meet you soon!

Cheers,
Terahard Team

notes.title: Dev Diary #3 - Our Beta is near!
notes.content:
[h2]Development Diary # 3[/h2]

You can now apply to test our beta on this [url=https://forms.gle/yRvGXcHQ9oA79MkJ8]link[/url]!! It's open to all and is completely free to play.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38219030/3d0868bd796704690c7862541e18535b54f62133.png[/img]

Lately we have been working hard on our beta. Here are some relevant ones being improved, fixed or implemented lately ~

- Spawn VFX on Teleporters
- Titan, Horde, Quick Hitter, and Kamikazee VFX
- New Brute Weapon and Animations
- Symbiosis Shaders for Enemies
- Changes in Badassery Meter Fireworks
- Camoblob Shader

[h2]Festival Announcement[/h2]

On other news, we are so happy to announce that we will be attending DreamHack Beyond's Indie Playground this July 24 - 30, 2021! 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38219030/50e1d6c5325515f2835dfdee628ae95294319880.gif[/img]

Get your free tickets [url=https://dreamhack.com/tickets/dhb1]here[/url] today and support us and other indie games as well!

notes.title: What's in store for June?
notes.content:
[h2][i]Hey, spaceketeers! 
You're hearing us live from the BADA Space Station.[/i][/h2]

This month's streaming event was a huge success and we are thrilled to know there are people out there who are as stoked as we are about our Steam release! Phew. A huge weight lifted off our chest.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38219030/c16393d497357519d22b229e58db9ae4a8432f4f.png[/img]

[h2][b]What's In Store For June?[/b][/h2]

You guessed it right; it's a new livestream event!
The team is passionately working on a new kickass build for our community to try. This time, we are focusing on our multiplayer feature our players will now be able to play with their friends! 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38219030/f4dfba807fdca141eefb1c88b0e042e1b86818ca.png[/img]

We gathered enough data from the last build from our lovely streamers and we are actively trying to improve the game from once it was. Soon we will be able to share with you the fruits of our labor! 

For the meantime, sit back, relax, and look forward to our next update, Spaceketeers!
Feel free to join our Discord for a chance to test our game yourself: discord.gg/pcuSnwU8MB
